subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Has Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer been published and verified through supported install channels, and should this fail-closed AWS upgrade boundary land in the same release window?
rationale: The code is technically sound, but merging determines when existing AWS cloud-worker setups begin requiring a new external binary contract and may become unavailable until upgraded.

options.title: Publish, Rebase, And Re-Prove
options.body: Release and verify Crabbox v0.38.1+, rebase this branch onto current main, and refresh exact-head and live AWS proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Immediate Cutoff
options.body: Merge before broad dependency availability and explicitly accept that AWS-backed workers using older supported installations will fail closed.

options.title: Hold The Hardening
options.body: Keep the PR paused if the upstream release or coordinated upgrade window cannot yet be guaranteed.

recommendation.title: Publish, Rebase, And Re-Prove
recommendation.body: Release and verify Crabbox v0.38.1+, rebase this branch onto current main, and refresh exact-head and live AWS proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current cloud-worker design and both sides of the OpenClaw–Crabbox contract in the available history.
